title: 第一章 火刑
content_zh:
“为什么要逮捕我？”一直站在人类，包括某些上等贵族之上的艾妮尔，做梦都没有想到过自己会有这么一天，随着情绪的无法遏制，她一掌击裂了石制的桌面，猛的站起。

    “请你注意自己的情绪，这种时候越是如此对你越是不利。”对面坐着的是她的律师，不是她请的，是法律程序上委派给她的，资历够老，但不可靠，可是话又说回来，在这种社会上，除了钱，又有什么是可靠的呢！

    “我没罪！”艾妮尔捏紧了双手，极力压下自己心中的怒气，坐了下来。

    “可是他们说你有罪，一切都是按法律程序走的，十分合法。”对面的他低头看着手中的文件，几张A4开面的白纸上密密麻麻的印着很多文字。

    “什么罪？”不论是出于好奇，还是不甘，艾妮尔很想知道，这些人类究竟给她找了些什么样的罪名。

    “屠杀罪，私藏枪支罪，还有叛国罪，这几项比较严重，其余的都是一些小罪名。”对方从文件中挑了几个看的上眼的罪名，情绪平静的抬头看着她，“看来不需要我费什么口舌了，这样的罪名不论成立哪一项，你的结局都是一样。”

    “……”艾妮尔沉默了一会，捏成拳的双手慢慢的展开，“这次又要我做什么，对付南方的叛民，还是北面的恐惧组织，或者魔王的爪牙！”

    从前每次都是这样，如果她不想做，那么他们就会想尽办法来逼她接手，方法各不相同，而那些任务往往都是很难完成的，不过这次竟然用到了逮捕，而且那么多条死刑的罪名，难道说让她直接去杀魔王？

    “我不明白小姐所指的是什么。”对方摇了摇头，他确实不知道，今天还是第一次与这位只在某些团体中出名的艾妮尔见面，对于围着这位小姐的某些潜规则，此时此地他应该没有必要再去了解了。

    “什么？”艾妮尔第二次激动的站了起来，松开的双手又握成了拳头。

    “明天是最后的审判日，请小姐做好心理准备，结果应该不会有太大的变化。”对方说着，也站了起来，只是他的站起是为了离开，离开这个监狱。

    “我要见斯多克公爵！”艾妮尔知道，如果还有希望，那么就在他的身上。

    “很对不起，小姐，斯多克公爵今天早上已经吩咐过，让我来看看你，并将你所犯罪刑的严重性，及可能的结果告诉你，现在我已经完成任务，明天再见！”说着，他转身向那个小门走去。

    “我没罪！”失去一切希望的艾妮尔突然冲着他吼道，面部因为不甘和愤怒变得扭曲。

    “也许！”律师转身，面对着她，“可能有些时候，只是需要这样一个结果，至于是什么原因，我只能说这样的原因一定存在，也许就像贵妇们需要新的谈资一样的荒谬，不过一定有它存在的必要。再见！”

    看着对方离开，厚厚的铁门重新关上，“砰”的巨响，将艾妮尔震醒。

The original expectations for a grand wedding in Xuanling Valley suddenly disappeared. All that was left was an empty castle and the groom. Is this kind of wedding what the bride expected?He knew without asking that no one was looking forward to such a wedding, so he had to decide something about it.

With a tap of his fingers, several little black bats flew out, flapping their wings and circling around him, while his lips opened and closed gently, not knowing what he was saying. After this continued for a while, the little bats flew away, and he sat down with peace of mind, rested, and waited. He believed that everything would continue as he had arranged, and Jiyingbao would return to its former glory.

In less than half a day, those cute and dark little bats were already resting in the hands of some important people, and each of them had different looks. They didn't look like they were happy to be invited to the wedding of the demon party chief elder, but more of a kind of confusion and suspicion.

However, whether they were puzzled, curious, or suspicious, in less than half a day, they had already jumped to Jiying Castle in Xuanling Valley with the things they had been ordered to do. Seeing everyone who came to attend the wedding, or who was asked to arrange the wedding, a satisfied smile gradually appeared on Philopus's face, but this smile was not the same in the eyes of every guest.

The most real one was Deputy Elder Yasir, "Great Elder, why did you suddenly say you want to get married?"

"Who is the bride?" Foy asked curiously.

"As long as the elder knows who the bride is, why are you two so anxious?" Of course, there is also Eggster, who always has a smile on his face and makes the two deputy elders hate him, but what can they do to him as equals?What's more, the great elder doesn't generally value him.

"Okay, you first decorate Jiyingbao, and then you will naturally meet the bride!" Phillips smiled and did not answer. He just turned and walked upstairs. He was not tired but just wanted to have some quiet time alone. Especially when facing these three deputy elders, he felt that silence was even more important.

"Great Elder..." Watching Philopus leave, Elder Yasser looked at a loss.

"Look! The great elder was scared away by you!" There was also Eggster who was gloating about his misfortune.

"You..." I had been feeling angry all along the way, but now that Eggster had provoked me like this, I could no longer suppress it and became furious.

"Okay, deputy elder, please calm down first. Eggster was just joking with you, and you should take it seriously!" Foy stepped forward to break up the fight, pulled Yasser aside, and did not forget to remind Eggster, "Eggste, the great elder seems to have asked you to prepare your clothes, don't forget it!"

"How could I forget!" As he said this, Eggster turned around and walked towards his room. He remembered to put the dress in his room, but no one was watching. He couldn't tell what would happen, so he had better keep an eye on it. Otherwise, if he didn't tell the great elder, he wouldn't know how he would be laughed at.

Watching Eggster walk away, Foy frowned, with a serious look on his face, "What do you think the great elder sang today?"

Yasser's anger has not subsided, and his mind is filled with Eggster's smiling face, "I don't know where he is singing from! I only know that if he continues like this, I will be pissed to death by him sooner or later!"

"I mean the Great Elder!" Foy pointed out.

"Great Elder?" Yasser was stunned for a moment, then came back to his senses, "You also find it strange?"

"How can it not be strange? Think about it, our elder has never been a person who would do anything for love, let alone get married!" Foy really couldn't understand that a person who regarded love as nothing could suddenly say that he wanted to get married one day.

"You mean the great elder didn't marry for love?" Yasser guessed.

"Maybe, but besides love, why would the Great Elder get married? In other words, what can marriage bring?" Foy can be said to be the person who knows Philopus best in the Demon Party, and based on his understanding of the Great Elder, it is absolutely impossible for him to get married, especially for the so-called love.Therefore, in his opinion, there must be another dark side to the great elder's wedding. As for what it is, only the great elder himself knows it now, and they can only guess here.

"Who knows!" Yasir shook his head helplessly. If he knew, he wouldn't ask, let alone be laughed at by that annoying guy.

"I think we'll find out soon!" Foy suddenly looked outside and smiled.

"What do you mean?" But the other party didn't understand what he meant at all. Outside?There was nothing outside, except for the darkening sky and the slowly climbing moon.

"It's dark!" As he saw, it was dark, but does it have anything to do with the elder's marriage?
